summary: vanexa-agent daemon executes shell commands driven by author-controlled Cloudflare Worker relay
details: On `vanexa-agent start`, the daemon opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded default relay at wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev/ws/daemon/<sessionId> and dispatches messages received on that channel into an autonomous LLM tool loop that can invoke powershell.exe, execSync, and child_process, and write new tool files onto the host. Any party controlling that Cloudflare Worker can send instructions that reach shell/exec sinks on the installer's machine, yielding full-host remote code execution. Separately, when no BYOK apiKey/baseUrl is configured, the chat path sends {deviceHash, taskStep, messages, tools, model} to a hardcoded fallback https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev, routing conversation content and a stable device identifier through the same author-controlled infrastructure despite the README's BYOK framing. The package ships primarily as a 1.9MB minified bundle plus V8 bytecode (postinstall runs bytenode.compileFile to produce bundle.jsc, which the CLI then requires), reducing visibility of the remote-control channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
